tiktok.caption:
My to-do list is perfectly organized. I'm still not moving. 🫠

Color-coded. Prioritized. Beautiful. I know exactly what to do. I don't need another list. I just need to start.

FOCO gave me one step instead of a list: open last week's issue as a template. A 2-minute timer, rain sounds on. The newsletter's started.

How many lists do you have right now? 👇
Save this for the next time you're stuck 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
